The verdict

The right choice depends on the feeling.

✦ Most breathtaking

The Jefferson. Spectacular Christmas decorations, grand architecture, and an indoor pool. Choose it for a proper splurge.

♡ Most intimate & easy

O.Henry. Only about an hour away, elegant rooms, and a special Nutcracker Tea if tickets can be secured. Regular holiday tea is sold out. No indoor pool, but excellent low-stress charm.

❖ Best budget

Hotel Roanoke. A dramatic historic hotel and dozens of trees for much less. More winter-driving exposure near the Blue Ridge.
